lines.en: I creep along the bamboo stalks.
My thick tail trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我从一根竹子跳到下一根。
lines.en: I hop from one bamboo to the next.
I work my way up the bamboo.
I slip between the bamboo leaves.
I go slowly. I don't want to fall.
I stand on a node, steady.
I go around a bamboo shoot.
I lean out to look below.

lines.zh: 我的毛色在竹影里很显。
lines.en: My coat shows against the bamboo.
I push into denser cover.
I slide down a stalk.
I climb a stretch and look back.
My claws grip the bamboo skin.
I step around a cut stump.
I retreat from the bamboo's edge.
I perch on a stalk, balanced.
There's not much to see from here.
I move only when the bamboo quiets.
I prick my ears to the wind.
I chew a tender shoot.
I keep out of people's way.
I hear something deeper in.
My face is a bit catlike.
I tuck my tail underneath.
I can't be bothered to lift a paw.
The wind sets the bamboo chattering.
I count the bamboo nodes.
Stay back; I will climb this tree.
Is that bamboo in your hand?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有竹子。
lines.en: I watch your hands for bamboo.

lines.zh: 竹子一递，我就不躲你了。
lines.en: Offer bamboo, and I stop hiding.
Standing like that makes me uneasy.
I tilt my head at your face.
Half a step back and I'll come down.
My claws are sharp.
I'm still deciding whether to bolt.
I cry out and climb.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成红色的球。
lines.en: I curl into a red ball.
I hide in the leaves.
A tuft of fur is pulled out.
Shaking hard. Even the bamboo leaves rattle.
I can't take much of this.
I tuck my tail and run.
I hide behind a stalk.
I lick the wound slowly.
I don't dare come down.
Bamboo! It's bamboo!
I come down the stalk slowly.
Let me lick it first.
Set it down. I'll take it myself.
This bamboo smells sweet.
That bamboo leaf in your hand is tender.
Another stalk, please.
I've sat down.
Tenderer than the forest's.
Touch me and I bolt up a stalk.
I leap off the bamboo.
Don't grab my tail.
I retreat behind a stalk.
You've pinned my forepaw.
The bump fluffs my fur up.
After the knock I hide farther off.
I climbed two nodes higher.
Another one is across the bamboo.

lines.zh: 我们用额头互相蹭了蹭。
lines.en: We rub our foreheads together.
Its tail is shorter than mine.
We gnaw the same stalk together.
It's less afraid of people than I am.
It leaves first, slowly.
There are many like us in this bamboo.
We each take a stalk.
Next time, right here.
I hug it like a bamboo stalk.
It slips from my paws.
This pearl is useless.
I hide it between nodes.
I check what fell.
I drag it up two nodes.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，不知道做什么。
lines.en: I hold it and don't know what for.
This bamboo is mine to nibble.
First I climb two nodes.
Bamboo leaves hide half of me.
It's below the bamboo.
I need to get into the leaves.
I look that way.
I won't call; it would give me away.
I've picked my escape route.
That sound is wrong.
I can bolt up any moment.
First I hold myself still.
It still circles by the roots.
I keep climbing.
The bamboo sways; it hasn't noticed.
I hide where the leaves are thickest.
I count the clicks of its claws.
It circled once and left.
I don't dare come down yet.
I switch from this stalk to that.
I can tell friend from foe.
Wait a little; it will move on.
The bamboo hides me and shields me.
I've tucked my tail in.
I swipe once with a claw.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手指，然后松口。
lines.en: I nip your finger and let go.

lines.zh: 我只拍了你一下，是警告。
lines.en: I only swat you once—a warning.
I claw and climb.
It didn't back off, so I hide.
I pounce and miss.
I'm guarding myself.
That scratch is nothing to you.

lines.zh: 我爬到它够不到的地方。
lines.en: I climb where it can't reach.
I poke my head out of the bamboo leaves.
A small shadow joins the bamboo.
I climb the nearest stalk.
The bamboo here is tender.
I come out the other side of the clump.

lines.zh: 我的毛色在影子里显眼。
lines.en: My coat shows in the shade.
I'm only at ease up high.
The bamboo wind is quiet today.
Fire sends me scrambling up.
Soaked, I scramble hard.

lines.zh: 响声把我从竹子上震下来。
lines.en: The bang knocks me off the bamboo.
Bamboo leaves don't stop arrows.
A flash and I'm dazed.
Hungry enough to chew old bamboo.
Thunder makes me curl tight.
I keep falling.
